page_hint: Ch14 §3 Step 2 TPOT bullet; Ch14 §8 mini-case; Ch15 §1 canonical SLO
quoted_clause: TPOT p50/p95 (SLO: p50 ≤ ~25 ms/token; record p95 for tail diagnosis, not SLO-bound).
observed: Ch14 treats p95 TPOT as diagnostic only, while Ch15 states the canonical SLO as 'TPOT median ≤ 25 ms, p95 ≤ 35 ms (Ch 4, Table 4-2)' and the Ch14 mini-case lists only 'median TPOT about 25 ms'.
correction: Align every TPOT SLO statement to the canonical Ch4/Ch15 definition: median ≤25 ms and p95 ≤35 ms. If p95 TPOT is intentionally diagnostic in a particular sweep, say so explicitly and explain why it is not the acceptance gate.
acceptance_test: Search all Ch14/Ch15 SLO statements and the mini-case; every TPOT threshold is identical (median ≤25 ms, p95 ≤35 ms), and no clause says p95 TPOT is 'not SLO-bound' unless it is explicitly scoped as an additional diagnostic.
verdict_evidence: chapter-14.md:37,:50 'p50 <= ~25 ms/token; p95 not SLO-bound' vs chapter-15.md:11 'TPOT median <= 25 ms, p95 <= 35 ms' and ch4:48,184; :30,:157 also drop p95.
fix_instruction: chapter-14.md:37 and :50: write 'p50 <= 25 ms, p95 <= 35 ms (Ch 4 Table 4-2)'; delete 'not SLO-bound' or scope it as extra.

page_hint: Ch14 §5 Common Mistakes, mean-only latency bullet
quoted_clause: A 0.84 s mean hides a 5 s tail that breaches the p95 SLO (Ch6).
observed: A 5 s tail breaches a p95 SLO only if more than 5% of the population exceeds the SLO threshold (or if the p95 itself is above threshold). A single 5 s request does not breach p95.
correction: Say 'can hide a tail; whether it breaches p95 depends on the fraction of requests above the threshold' or specify that more than 5% exceed 2 s.
acceptance_test: The common-mistake bullet states the percentile condition or gives a frequency that justifies the breach.
verdict_evidence: chapter-14.md:130 'a 5 s tail that breaches the p95 SLO' — tail breaches p95 only if >5% exceed threshold; no frequency given.
fix_instruction: chapter-14.md:130: 'can hide a 5 s tail; a p95 breach needs >5% above 2 s' (or state that fraction).

quoted_clause: TPOT median ≤ 25 ms, p95 ≤ 35 ms (Ch 4, Table 4-2)
observed: Ch15 states that the canonical SLO includes a TPOT p95 bound, while Ch14 explicitly says TPOT p95 is recorded for tail diagnosis and is not SLO-bound.
correction: Align both chapters with Ch4 Table 4-2. If p95 TPOT ≤ 35 ms is an SLO, update Ch14 so the deployment benchmark enforces it in acceptance and goodput. If it is only a diagnostic target, remove 'p95 ≤ 35 ms' from Ch15's canonical SLO or label it as a non-SLO diagnostic bound.
acceptance_test: A reader can state one canonical TPOT SLO set, and Ch14's benchmark acceptance criteria and Ch15's measured SLO use the same percentiles and thresholds.
verdict_evidence: ch14:37 'p50 <= ~25 ms; p95 not SLO-bound' vs ch15:11 'TPOT median <= 25 ms, p95 <= 35 ms' and ch4:48/:75; three-way split.
fix_instruction: Make Ch14:37 match Ch4 Table 4-2: state TPOT p50 <= 25 ms and p95 <= 35 ms as SLOs, include p95 TPOT in Step-2 acceptance criteria, or drop 'p95 <= 35 ms' from Ch15:11/Ch4:48.

quoted_clause: Its separate 50-step table adds SageAttention, compilation, and feature caching, and reports 96.78 versus 58.39 seconds for the same shape.
observed: It is unclear whether 96.78 and 58.39 are total seconds for 50 steps or seconds per step. If per step, they are not directly comparable to the earlier 5.5070/2.9475 seconds per step without explanation; if total, the unit should be stated.
correction: Specify 'total seconds for 50 steps' or 'seconds per step in the 50-step table', matching the source table.
acceptance_test: A reader can tell whether the 96.78/58.39 values are per-step or total without consulting the source.
verdict_evidence: ch14:108 '96.78 versus 58.39 seconds' unit scope unstated: as totals 1.94/1.17 s/step; as per-step contradicts 5.51/2.95 line.
fix_instruction: Write 'reports 96.78 versus 58.39 seconds total for the 50 steps (~1.94 vs 1.17 s/step)' so the unit and relation to per-step figures are explicit.

quoted_clause: Retrieved 2026-10-28. Timing results are vendor-reported, not measurements made for this book.
observed: Ch16 explicitly labels a 2026-10-28 source as 'outside the book's 2026-08-30 evidence cutoff — post-cutoff sources are admitted only as dated, vendor-reported context'. The Ch14 video footnotes also have 2026-10-28 retrieval dates but do not carry the same post-cutoff label, creating an inconsistent evidence-status convention.
correction: Add the same post-cutoff/vendor-reported context label to Ch14 footnotes, or state the cutoff convention once and ensure all post-cutoff sources carry it.
acceptance_test: All sources retrieved after the stated evidence cutoff are labeled consistently as post-cutoff vendor-reported context.
verdict_evidence: ch14:159,:161 'Retrieved 2026-10-28. Timing results are vendor-reported' no post-cutoff label; convention elsewhere explicit (ch10:191, ch15:120, ch16:165); Ch14 has zero 'cutoff'.
fix_instruction: Append the standard label to the ~2026-10-28 Ch14 footnotes: 'outside the book's 2026-08-30 evidence cutoff — post-cutoff sources are admitted only as dated, vendor-reported context'.

quoted_clause: 4. **Include goodput and cost, not just latency** — the SLO-windowed throughput and $/request complete the picture for the economics (Ch16). | Table 14-1: 'Deployment benchmark | ... | TTFT/TPOT p50-p99, goodput, KV util, $/request |'
observed: The chapter's own measurement habit and its own comparison table both list cost per request as a required deployment-benchmark output, but the nine-row result worksheet that the chapter tells the reader to fill in has no cost row. The worksheet is the artifact the reader will actually copy, so the omission propagates into the benchmark the chapter is trying to shape.
correction: Add a cost row (e.g. 'Cost per SLO-meeting request | $/request at the measured goodput, with the priced-occupancy basis stated | Ch 16 model | [UNMEASURED]') so the worksheet satisfies habit 4 and matches Table 14-1's metric list.
acceptance_test: Every metric listed in Table 14-1's deployment-benchmark row has a corresponding worksheet row, and the worksheet's rows map one-to-one onto the chapter's four measurement habits.
verdict_evidence: Worksheet rows Ch14:48-56 have no cost row; habit 4 (Ch14:76) and Table 14-1 deployment row (Ch14:67) both list $/request.
fix_instruction: Add a 'Cost per SLO-meeting request | $/request at measured goodput, priced-occupancy basis stated | Ch 16 model | [UNMEASURED]' row.
